title: Deception Detection Rate: How Effectively Can Current Monitors Detect Strategic Action Hiding by AI Agents?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Compelling chain: test three monitor types against action-hiding traces -> measure detection rates -> identify monitor blind spots. If LLM monitors share blind spots with hiding LLMs, the entire monitoring paradigm is challenged. Critical finding either way.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires creating 50 agent traces (25 with hidden actions, 25 benign) and testing three monitor types. Rule-based and LLM monitors are accessible; the trace generation with realistic hidden actions is the harder part.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Well-defined deliverable: detection rate and false positive rate for three monitors on 50 traces. Clear metrics, focused comparison. Could start with one monitor type as first milestone.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
